caption: The drawing contains two rectangular panels, each featuring botanical designs on a beige background. The upper, larger panel shows a horizontal arrangement of stylized flowers, leaves, and stems. The composition includes pink and white petals, blue and green leaves, and a central round flower with layered scalloped petals outlined in pink and yellow dotted patterns. Blue leaves with textured veins are interspersed with smaller green leaves and rounded white berries attached to brown and green stems that arc across the panel. The lower, smaller panel depicts a simpler, curved floral sprig with a blue leaf, small green leaves, and clusters of round pink and white buds, along with stems tipped by blue and pink small flowers or buds. Both designs are framed by thin pencil lines, and the overall color palette consists mainly of blue, green, pink, white, and brown set against a neutral beige background.
title: Embroidery - Detail of Child's Dress
